prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change

When `EscrowFinish` / `EscrowCancel` unlock an MPT escrow and the receiver has no `MPToken`, and the submitter cannot auto-create it, xrpld returns `tecNO_PERMISSION`. The same code is used for FinishAfter / CancelAfter failures, so clients cannot tell a missing holding apart from a timing failure.

Under `fixCleanup3_5_0`, return `tecNO_ENTRY` for that missing-holding case. Without the fix, keep `tecNO_PERMISSION`. Auto-create rules are unchanged. Only the destination/recipient submitter may create the holding.

Option B for https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/issues/8587
Option A (spec documents current `tecNO_PERMISSION`): https://github.com/XRPLF/XRPL-Standards/pull/671

## Context of Change

Live TokenEscrow returns `tecNO_PERMISSION` here (Testnet repro in #8587). XLS-85 originally said `tecNO_ENTRY`. Option A updates the spec to match current code. This PR is the optional cleanup that switches to a holding-specific TEC when `fixCleanup3_5_0` is enabled.

Uses the existing `fixCleanup3_5_0` amendment (no new amendment name). IOU missing trust lines still use `tecNO_LINE`.

Code: `escrowUnlockApplyHelper<MPTIssue>` in `include/xrpl/ledger/helpers/EscrowHelpers.h`.

## API Impact

- [ ] Public API: New feature (new methods and/or new fields)
- [ ] Public API: Breaking change (in general, breaking changes should only impact the next api_version)
- [x] `libxrpl` change (any change that may affect `libxrpl` or dependents of `libxrpl`)
- [ ] Peer protocol change (must be backward compatible or bump the peer protocol version)

After `fixCleanup3_5_0` is enabled, this failure mode returns `tecNO_ENTRY` instead of `tecNO_PERMISSION`. No new RPC methods/fields. No peer protocol change.

## Before / After

Current behavior: third party finishes an MPT escrow whose destination has no `MPToken` → `tecNO_PERMISSION`.

With `fixCleanup3_5_0` enabled: same case → `tecNO_ENTRY`.
With `fixCleanup3_5_0` disabled: still `tecNO_PERMISSION`.

Destination finishing themselves still auto-creates the `MPToken` and returns `tesSUCCESS`.

## Test Plan

- Updated `src/test/app/EscrowToken_test.cpp` (`testMPTFinishDoApply`): on/off loop for `fixCleanup3_5_0`, asserting `tecNO_ENTRY` when enabled and `tecNO_PERMISSION` when disabled.
- Ran locally: `./.build/xrpld --unittest=EscrowToken` → 0 failures.

## Future Tasks

- If this lands, follow up on XLS-85 for post-amendment `tecNO_ENTRY`.
- Option A alone (spec sync) is also a valid resolution of #8587. This PR is separable.
